# ETCS build dependencies -- Debian family (debian, ubuntu, raspbian)
#
# FORMAT:  <package-name>   <probe>   [# comment]
#
# The PACKAGE NAME is the only distro-specific thing on each line. The
# PROBE is distro-independent -- it tests whether the thing is actually
# usable, not whether some package manager believes it is installed. That
# split is the whole point of this format: porting to Fedora means copying
# this file to linux-fedora.txt and changing the left column only.
#
# PROBES:
#   pkgconfig:NAME   pkg-config --exists NAME
#   binary:NAME      found on PATH
#   header:PATH      found under a standard include dir
#   none             no probe available; presence is assumed, never checked
#
# Probes answer "is it here", NOT "will this tree compile here" -- see
# `ace deps arch` for the second question. A machine can pass every probe
# below and still fail to run ETCS (io_uring disabled by sysctl, ld.gold
# removed from the distro, wrong page size). Keep the two separate.

# --- Toolchain ---------------------------------------------------------
build-essential   binary:g++            # g++, make, libc headers
pkg-config        binary:pkg-config     # every probe below leans on this
binutils-gold     binary:ld.gold        # loaders/Makefile passes -fuse-ld=gold
cmake             binary:cmake          # widely used build system in modules
python3           binary:python3        # same as above
python3-jsonschema none                 # same as above

# --- Runtime libraries -------------------------------------------------
liburing-dev      pkgconfig:liburing    # ThreadPool.h
libsqlite3-dev    pkgconfig:sqlite3     # database scripting layer
libmbedtls-dev    header:mbedtls/ssl.h  # MbedTLSContext (no .pc file on 2.x)

# --- Development ------------------------------------------------------
gdb               binary:gdb
lldb              binary:lldb
